heading.en: Two diseases that hijack our own cells

hook.en: HIV attacks the very cells that defend us. In cancer, our own cells forget how to stop dividing. Both are serious, and both are better understood than ever.
hook.kn: HIV ನಮ್ಮನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವ ಕೋಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆಯೇ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಕೋಶಗಳು ವಿಭಜನೆ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಮರೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: HIV attacks the very cells that defend us. In cancer, our own cells forget how to stop dividing. Both are serious, and both are better understood than ever.
narration.kn: HIV ನಮ್ಮನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವ ಕೋಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆಯೇ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಕೋಶಗಳು ವಿಭಜನೆ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಮರೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: AIDS (Acquired Immuno Deficiency Syndrome) was first reported in 1981. It is caused by HIV, a retrovirus with an RNA genome. HIV spreads through sexual contact with an infected person, transfusion of contaminated blood, sharing infected needles, and from an infected mother to her child through the placenta; it does not spread by touch. HIV enters macrophages, where its RNA is copied into viral DNA by reverse transcriptase; the DNA joins the host DNA, and macrophages keep producing virus (an HIV factory). HIV then attacks helper T-lymphocytes (T_H), whose number falls, so the patient suffers infections by Mycobacterium, viruses, fungi and Toxoplasma. ELISA is the common diagnostic test; anti-retroviral drugs only prolong life. NACO and NGOs educate people.
body.kn: ಏಡ್ಸ್ 1981ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು ವರದಿಯಾಯಿತು. HIV ರೆಟ್ರೋವೈರಸ್. ಅದು ಮ್ಯಾಕ್ರೋಫೇಜ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರಿವರ್ಸ್ ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್‌ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟೇಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ DNA ಆಗಿ, ನಂತರ ಸಹಾಯಕ T ಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಶಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ELISA ಪತ್ತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ.

points.en: Macrophage = HIV factory; helper T cells fall
Spreads by sex, blood, needles, mother to child

ELISA is the common diagnostic test; anti-retroviral drugs only prolong life. NACO and NGOs educate people.
narration.kn: ಏಡ್ಸ್ 1981ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು ವರದಿಯಾಯಿತು. HIV ರೆಟ್ರೋವೈರಸ್. ಅದು ಮ್ಯಾಕ್ರೋಫೇಜ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರಿವರ್ಸ್ ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್‌ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟೇಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ DNA ಆಗಿ, ನಂತರ ಸಹಾಯಕ T ಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಶಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ELISA ಪತ್ತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ.

body.en: Normal cells show contact inhibition: contact with other cells stops their growth. Cancer cells lose this property and form tumours. Benign tumours stay in their original location; malignant tumours invade surrounding tissue and spread through the blood to distant sites: metastasis. Carcinogens include ionising radiation (X-rays, gamma rays), non-ionising radiation (UV), chemicals in tobacco smoke, and oncogenic viruses with viral oncogenes. Normal cells carry proto-oncogenes (cellular oncogenes) which, when activated, can cause cancer. Detection uses biopsy and histopathology, blood and bone-marrow tests for leukaemia, radiography, CT and MRI, and monoclonal antibodies. Treatment includes surgery, radiotherapy, chemotherapy and immunotherapy with biological response modifiers such as α-interferon.
body.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕೋಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ನಿರೋಧ ಇದೆ; ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಅದನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ. ಹಾನಿಕಾರಕ ಗಡ್ಡೆಗಳು ಮೆಟಾಸ್ಟಾಸಿಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಹರಡುತ್ತವೆ. X-ಕಿರಣ, UV, ತಂಬಾಕು ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕಗಳು ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್ ಕಾರಕಗಳು. ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ: ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ, ವಿಕಿರಣ, ಕೀಮೋಥೆರಪಿ, α-ಇಂಟರ್‌ಫೆರಾನ್.

points.en: Carcinogens: X-rays, UV, tobacco, oncogenic viruses

problem.en: Explain step by step how HIV infection leads to AIDS.

steps.en: HIV enters macrophages; reverse transcriptase copies its RNA into DNA, which joins the host DNA.
Infected macrophages keep making virus; HIV then enters helper T-lymphocytes and multiplies.
Helper T cells are progressively destroyed, so immunity collapses.
The patient becomes prone to opportunistic infections such as Mycobacterium, fungi and Toxoplasma.

answer.en: Macrophages → helper T cells destroyed → immunodeficiency → opportunistic infections
